name: tanstack-query
install: corepack enable >/dev/null 2>&1; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --reporter=silent || pnpm install --reporter=silent
source: 51 first-parent commits of main before 2026-11-17 (Nx-managed Vitest monorepo, 27 packages; CI runs `nx affected --target=test:lib` per package). The harness adds an untracked root vitest.config.mts that runs every package as a Vitest project (each package's own config extended, `dir` set to its src).
